id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying stytch product line mismatches

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion and error classification, potentially distinguishing credential errors from product-line mismatches to avoid unnecessary retries.
review.reason: Adds a dictionary `PRODUCT_LINE_MISMATCH_MESSAGES` and comments explaining disjoint API surfaces for Stytch credential and product-line failures. This could support warehouse ingestion by distinguishing credential errors from product-line mismatches, potentially avoiding unnecessary retries or misclassification.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the `error_message_matches` helper or the `get_non_retryable_errors` changes, nor the actual transport and retry classification. Tests assert classification exists, but supporting implementation and exact matching behavior are not supplied, preventing a complete assessment of tier and confidence.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the `error_message_matches` helper or the `get_non_retryable_errors` changes in the source, nor the actual transport and retry classification. The tests assert that a classification exists, but the supporting implementation and the exact matching behavior are not supplied. This prevents a complete assessment of tier and confidence.
